question: Which 2024 India-Bangladesh energy project involves a 765 kV cross-border transmission line to boost hydroelectric trade across multiple countries?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Katihar-Parbotipur-Bornagar Interconnection Project**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Katihar-Parbotipur-Bornagar Interconnection Project involves the construction of a **765 kV cross-border transmission line** between India and Bangladesh.
 
• This project aims to **enhance hydroelectric power trade** across multiple countries, including Bhutan and Nepal, leveraging the regional energy grid.
 
• The interconnection will serve as a critical infrastructure for **energy security and economic cooperation** between India and Bangladesh.
 
• It is expected to facilitate the **export of surplus electricity from India** to Bangladesh and other neighboring nations.
 
• The project is part of India's broader vision of **regional energy integration** to promote sustainable development in South Asia.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Regional Energy Integration**

 
 
• India's energy projects with Bangladesh and other neighboring countries aim to create a **South Asian energy hub**, facilitating sustainable development and reducing energy deficits.
 
• Such initiatives promote **cross-border electricity trade**, regional cooperation, and infrastructure development.
 
• The Katihar-Parbotipur-Bornagar Interconnection Project is a key example of India's commitment to **regional energy security**.
